title: Source Registry (knowledge/sources.yaml)
description: Maps each source_id to a retained references/ document, its tier, and its role. Enforces Constitution I source-traceability and the FR-040/FR-042 definition-vs-method distinction at load time.

ref.description: Path to the retained document. REQUIRED when retention='retained' (MUST exist on disk — FR-024). Omitted when retention='recommended' (analyst-asserted, FR-046).

role.description: 'definition' grounds a smell's meaning or a Layer 1 structure; 'method' is detection/SOTA evidence only and MUST NOT be used as a rule's definition source or to ground a structure (FR-042).

retention.description: 'retained' = PDF present under references/ (ref required). 'recommended' = analyst-asserted citation, PDF not yet retained — admissible for BOTH Layer 1 structure and Layer 2 detection grounding (FR-046, amended 2026-06-24 decision B). A standard/notation-tier definition still needs paper-tier method evidence to ship (FR-040); a method-role source may never define (FR-042).
